name: Combobox
description: Mortar combobox: a searchable single select that filters options by label and announces when nothing matches.

props.label: string
props.options: ChoiceOption[] ({ value: string; label: string; description?: string; leading?: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean })
props.empty: { title: string; description?: string; action?: ReactNode } (default { title: "No matches" })

contract.usage: Import { Combobox } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
